narrativeProgression.description: Host asks about the current state of AI and machine learning.
Chris Benson explains the three key ingredients that led to the AI revolution: cloud computing, modern algorithms, and big data.
Host asks about the difference between AI and machine learning.
Chris Benson defines machine learning and explains its connection to AI, particularly deep learning.
Host asks how businesses can apply AI in the real world.
Chris Benson suggests developing an AI strategy based on data strategy, focusing on problems that lend themselves to AI solutions.
Host asks about the future of AI in the workplace.
Chris Benson argues that AI will not replace humans but will instead “supercharge” them.
Chris Benson paints a scenario of a future workplace where humans interact seamlessly with AI-powered systems.
